Export Options

Getting Started

  1. Go to the Settings tab and enter your license code to activate the extension.
  2. Navigate to any GoHighLevel sub-account page in your browser. The extension works on all GHL domains including white-labeled ones.
  3. Open the extension popup. Your Location ID will be auto-detected from the current page.
  4. Choose which asset types to export (all selected by default), pick your format, and click Export.
  5. Two files will download: an Excel/CSV file with organized sheets, and a JSON file with full untruncated data.

AI Workflow Analysis (Optional)

  1. In Settings, enter your OpenAI API key and click Test to verify it works.
  2. Check "Enable AI analysis for workflows" to turn it on.
  3. When you export, each workflow will be sent to GPT for analysis. Two extra columns are added: AI Description and AI Setup Notes.
Note: AI analysis adds processing time (~2s per workflow) and uses your OpenAI API credits. It can be toggled off at any time.

What Gets Exported

  • Excel file - One sheet per asset type, plus a Summary and Master List sheet. Some very long values may be truncated to fit Excel's 32,767 character cell limit.
  • JSON file - Complete, untruncated data for every asset. Use this as the source of truth when Excel cells are cut off.
  • Enriched assets - Workflows, funnels, forms, calendars, pipelines, email templates, and more are enriched with full configuration details beyond the basic listing.
  • 30+ asset types - Custom fields, tags, pipelines, workflows, funnels, forms, calendars, campaigns, templates, knowledge bases, AI employees, voice AI agents, documents, and more.

Tips

  • Keep the GHL tab open during export. You can close the popup - the export runs in the background.
  • For large accounts with many workflows, expect the export to take a few minutes.
  • If the export stalls, use the X button on the overlay to dismiss it, then try again.
  • The JSON file is ideal for feeding into AI tools or other automation platforms.
